title: Causal-diamond thermalization induces nonseparability in N-partite quantum systems
summary: We investigate the nonseparability of multipartite bosonic and fermionic $GHZ$ and $W$ states in a causal diamond spacetime using the Abe-Rajagopal (AR) $q$-conditional entropy. The finite lifetime of the observer gives rise to a causal diamond horizon, which induces an Unruh-like thermal effect and leads to a nontrivial restructuring of nonseparability in $N$-partite systems.
